preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t > 0 and t <= 30
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a positive integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 30) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and ' ' in line and int(line.split()[0]) == n)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is a positive integer (1 ≤ n ≤ 100) representing the size of set X.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= m <= 30 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and ' ' in line and int(line.split()[1]) == m)
preconditions.description: For each test case, m is a positive integer (1 ≤ m ≤ 30) representing the number of subsets S_i.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= x < n for x in map(int, line.split()[2:])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and ' ' in line)
preconditions.description: Each subset S_i contains distinct integers between 0 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(any(x in map(int, line.split()[2:]) for x in range(n)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and ' ' in line)
preconditions.description: Every integer in X (0 to n-1) appears in at least one subset S_i.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == ' '.join(str(int(min_atoms)) for min_atoms in [int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a single integer representing the minimum number of atoms k such that X is partitioned into atoms A1, ..., Ak, where each atom A_i is either a subset of some S_j or disjoint from all S_j.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= n for k in [int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: The minimum number of atoms k for each test case is at least 1 and at most n (the size of X).
